business_problem: NAB needed a more digital HR experience so employees could stop relying on manual email, limited call-center hours, and disconnected systems for policies, requests, and urgent guidance during periods of workforce disruption and talent shortages.
solution_summary: NAB made ServiceNow HR Service Delivery the foundation of a new employee-experience layer called Colleague Connect. The portal was implemented in 14 weeks and provides a branded destination where staff can ask questions through an always-on chatbot, receive automated answers, confirm policy acknowledgements, and access a wiki-style library of HR knowledge without waiting for a service representative. HR teams use the same environment to push alerts and manage cases, so communications, support, and documentation no longer live across separate tools. Because colleagues across the bank operate on the same platform, cases are easier to track and cross-team collaboration is simpler than under the prior fragmented model. NAB is also positioning the platform to integrate with Workday so people data and service actions can eventually be injected directly into employees' daily flow of work.

solution_components.name: HR Service Delivery
solution_components.role: Provides the underlying workflow platform for NAB's HR support transformation.

solution_components.name: Colleague Connect
solution_components.role: Acts as NAB's centralized employee portal for HR support, case visibility, and alerts.

solution_components.name: Colleague Connect chatbot
solution_components.role: Supplies automated, 24-hour answers to common employee questions and requests.

solution_components.name: Knowledge library
solution_components.role: Stores HR guidance that employees and chatbot interactions can reuse and improve over time.

data_flow: Employees enter Colleague Connect through the portal and chatbot for HR questions, policy acknowledgements, and case tracking. The chatbot and knowledge library handle routine information needs first, while HR Service Delivery routes the remaining work to support teams that also use the same portal to publish alerts and manage follow-up actions.
business_outcome: NAB launched Colleague Connect in 14 weeks, surpassed 5,000 chatbot users, grew chatbot usage about 30% per month, increased knowledge-library views by 49%, and reduced HR operating costs by 12-15% while giving bankers more time back for customer work.
